issues.description: Return type mismatch for Farm.singFarmSong() and its helper singFarmSongVerse(Animal): The problem statement's UML and task text specify singFarmSong() should print the song (void) and the template declares public void singFarmSong() and a private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal) that prints lines. The solution implementation, however, changes these to return String (singFarmSong() returns String and singFarmSongVerse(Animal) returns String). This structural difference (void vs String) can confuse students about the intended method contract and how the song should be produced (printed vs returned), and may cause incompatibility with tests or the provided template code.
issues.suggested_fix: Align the solution with the problem statement and template by changing the solution methods to print the song and have void return types: make singFarmSong() return void and singFarmSongVerse(Animal) return void (printing the song directly). Alternatively, if returning the song text is preferred for testing purposes, update the problem statement UML and the template method signatures/comments to indicate that singFarmSong() returns a String (and update any tests/instructions accordingly). Prefer the first option to match the existing UML and explicit task text which require printing.
